a paid visit had NO invoice until one was requested, then got INV-2026-0000001. The receipt number appears automatically on payment; the invoice number only when someone asks — which is why "where is the invoice number" is usually "nobody pressed the button"
the same visit carries receipt #4 and invoice #2 from two SEPARATE counters — a bill is what is owed, a receipt is proof of payment, and they must never share a sequence
a Rs 1,000 discount on a Rs 3,000 visit is HELD: status "pending", 1 approval row(s), and the bill still reads Rs 3,000 — the full amount. This is the workflow working, not a calculation error
bill before approval Rs 3,000, after approval Rs 2,000 — the discount applies the moment it is approved, and only then
a REJECTED discount leaves the bill at Rs 3,000 — the patient is charged in full, which is the only safe reading of a refusal
